card.name: Inside all-caps warning phrases
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word split inside an all-caps instruction, such as FREE in DO NOT FREEZE or BACK in NON-HORMONAL BACKUP. It also fires on AP in WRAP-UP and MID in MID TERM.

modes.label: Other capitalised compounds
modes.description: Start of a capitalised compound word outside drug labels, such as WRAP-UP or MID TERM.
modes.example: NO PAPER WILL BE ACCEPTED AFTER THE<< MID>> TERM.

card.writes: It seems to push the next piece toward capital-letter word continuations and away from US- or CI-type pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of a word in shouted all-caps warnings, especially DO NOT FREEZE.
